definitions.gloss: cuff; the end opening of a sleeve where the hand comes out
definitions.explanation: The opening at the end of a sleeve on a shirt, jacket, or other garment — the part that encircles the wrist. Refers to the opening itself as well as to any band, cuff, or trim around it.

examples.japanese: {袖口|そでぐち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{汚|よご}れている→汚れる：01293_yogoreru⟧。
⟦シャツ→シャツ：01052_shatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{袖口|そでぐち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ボタン→ボタン：02963_botan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧とれてしまった。
examples.english: The button on my shirt cuff came off.

examples.japanese: ⟦{寒|さむ}かった→寒い：00664_samui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦コート→コート：01358_kooto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{袖口|そでぐち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦きつく→きつい：02342_kitsui⟧⟦{締|し}めて→締める：10057_shimeru⟧⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: Since it was cold, I tightened the cuffs of my coat before going outside.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{袖|そで}→袖：02217_sode⟧ ('sleeve') and ⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧ ('opening/mouth'). Refers to the hand-end opening of a sleeve, in contrast to the shoulder-end where the sleeve attaches to the body of the garment.

USAGE:
- Used for all kinds of garments — dress shirts, jackets, sweaters, kimono, lab coats — whenever the opening at the wrist is meant.
- Can refer specifically to the cuff band/trim (e.g., on a dress shirt) or more generally to the sleeve opening itself.
- Commonly discussed in contexts of fit, cleanliness (the cuffs being the first part to get dirty), and fashion details.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {袖口|そでぐち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{汚|よご}れる→汚れる：01293_yogoreru⟧: the cuffs get dirty
- {袖口|そでぐち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{折|お}り{返|かえ}す→折り返す：21024_orikaesu⟧: to roll up / fold back the cuffs
- {袖口|そでぐち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ボタン→ボタン：02963_botan⟧: the cuff button
- {袖口|そでぐち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ほつれる: the cuff becomes frayed
- ⟦シャツ→シャツ：01052_shatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{袖口|そでぐち}: the cuff of a shirt

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{袖|そで}→袖：02217_sode⟧: sleeve — the whole sleeve, not just the opening.
- ⟦{袖|そで}なし→袖なし：23859_sodenashi⟧: sleeveless — a garment without sleeves.
- ⟦{襟|えり}→襟：06487_eri⟧: collar — neckline counterpart.
- ⟦{裾|すそ}→裾：06488_suso⟧: hem — bottom opening of a garment, analogous to {袖口|そでぐち} but at the bottom.
